text:
I’ll inspect the repository structure and its content/configuration surfaces, then trace SEO and GEO signals to exact file/line locations and report only actionable findings.

## SEO/GEO audit findings

| Priority | File:line | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| **High** | `src/_includes/base.njk:8` | Every page declares a **staging canonical URL**, causing production pages to canonicalize to the wrong host. | Generate the canonical from `geo.config.json` or an environment variable using `https://www.brightside-dental.example`. |
| **High** | `src/services.njk:5` and `src/sitemap.xml:4` | `/services/` is `noindex` but is included in the sitemap and linked prominently. This prevents a key commercial page from ranking and creates conflicting signals. | Remove `noindex` from the services page, or remove it from the sitemap and navigation if intentionally private. |
| **High** | `src/contact.njk:10` | JSON-LD is invalid JSON because of the trailing comma after `"telephone"`. Search engines may ignore the entire entity. | Remove the trailing comma and validate the structured data. |
| **High** | `src/contact.njk:10` | The `Dentist` schema is incomplete: no address, URL, geographic data, opening hours, service area, logo, or `sameAs` profiles. | Add complete `Dentist`/`LocalBusiness` data matching the visible business details. |
| **High** | `src/team.njk:3-6` | The Team page has no meta description and contains no dentist names, credentials, specialties, or individual profile data. This weakens E-E-A-T and AI answer extraction. | Add a description and detailed, verifiable clinician profiles with qualifications and specialties. |
| **Medium** | `src/_includes/base.njk:7` | `description` is rendered unconditionally. `team.njk` has no description, so its output contains an empty meta description. | Require descriptions in page front matter or provide a safe site-wide fallback. |
| **Medium** | `src/_includes/base.njk:6-9` | There are no Open Graph or Twitter/X metadata tags, reducing control over social previews and secondary discovery. | Add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:type`, `og:image`, and Twitter card metadata. |
| **Medium** | `src/contact.njk:8` | `data-nosnippet` hides useful insurance information from search snippets and AI-generated answers. | Remove it unless there is a specific legal reason to suppress this content. |
| **Medium** | `src/index.njk:7` and `src/team.njk:6` | Important claims such as “Trusted by thousands” and “decades of experience” are unsupported and lack evidence that search/AI systems can verify. | Replace with specific evidence: review counts and source, clinician experience by person, registrations, awards, or policies. |
| **Medium** | `src/index.njk:6-9`, `src/services.njk:7-9`, `src/contact.njk:6-8` | Content is very thin for local and AI search: no detailed treatment explanations, eligibility, pricing context, emergency process, opening hours, accessibility, FAQs, or service-area information. | Expand pages with directly answerable, fact-based sections and dedicated pages for major treatments and local intent. |
| **Medium** | `geo.config.json:1` and `.eleventy.js:1` | The configured production origin and `aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"` policy are not consumed by the Eleventy build. They do not affect canonical tags, robots, or generated output. | Wire this configuration into the templates/build, or remove it and maintain one authoritative configuration source. |
| **Low** | `src/_includes/base.njk:2` | The document has no `lang` attribute, reducing language/accessibility clarity. | Use `<html lang="en-GB">`. |
| **Low** | `src/robots.txt:1-3` | Robots allows all crawlers, but does not explicitly document AI crawler policy. The current policy is permissive only by implication. | Keep `Allow: /` if intended, and ensure the effective robots policy explicitly matches the desired AI crawler policy. |

The most urgent fixes are the production canonical URL, the `services` noindex/sitemap conflict, invalid JSON-LD, and the empty Team-page description.
